IMS566 Advanced Project (v2)
===========================

What is included
- Login / Register (client-side)
- Dashboard with charts (Chart.js)
- Users page with full CRUD (localStorage simulation)
- Theme toggle (dark/light) saved to localStorage
- Modular components (navbar loaded dynamically)
- Responsive layout and animations
- All code is client-side for easy submission

How to run
1. Unzip project
2. Open index.html in a modern browser (Chrome recommended)
3. Login (seeded user): username: admin  password: 123
4. Or register a new account

Files of interest
- index.html, register.html, dashboard.html, users.html
- styles.css
- js/* (api.js, auth.js, charts.js, table.js, components.js, theme.js)

Notes
This project simulates server-side operations using localStorage to meet assignment requirements for authentication, data views, data visualisation, content organisation, and responsive design.
